expected_diagnosis: PORTS chỉ có 8080/tcp, docker port rỗng và PortBindings{}; chưa thấy host port publish.
recommended_next_checks: So network mode, listener ứng dụng, proxy và yêu cầu public/private với owner.
resolution_guidance: Dùng proxy hoặc publish đúng interface theo change có ACL/TLS, không expose mù.
verification: Đúng endpoint host/public truy cập được theo thiết kế, không lộ port ngoài phạm vi.
escalate_when: Cần thay đổi Docker host/provider firewall hoặc kiến trúc chưa rõ.
production_warning: EXPOSE không tự publish; mở public có thể làm lộ backend vốn private.
referenceNoteEn:
Issue: Container application is unreachable through the VPS IP.
Findings: The container exposes TCP/8080, but Docker reported no published host port; PortBindings was empty. Container reachability does not establish external access.
Next Action: Confirm whether access should use a reverse proxy or an approved host-port mapping. Do not expose the application publicly without owner approval.
Verification: Test the intended HTTP endpoint from an external client and verify that no unintended port is exposed.
Status: Pending owner confirmation and external-access verification.
